desc: Design an O(|S|) method to find the longest palindromic suffix of S, such as KMP on reverse(S) + '#' + S.
Implement KMP prefix-function on reverse(S) + '#' + S to obtain the longest palindromic suffix length.
Construct the final palindrome by appending the reverse of the prefix before that palindromic suffix to S.
Read input, print result, and verify sample tests.
